declared_section_ambiguities: No controlled relation in the vocabulary (has-mcl, has-mclg, has-mrdl, has-mrdlg, requires-monitoring, compliance-basis, applies-to, defined-as, requires-treatment-technique) precisely captures a 'requires-notification-to-new-customers' obligation; 'applies-to' was used as the nearest approximation for c1 and c2 rather than guessing a more specific relation.

evidence.exact_text: Community water systems must give a copy of the most recent public notice for any continuing violation, the existence of a variance or exemption, or other ongoing situations requiring a public notice to all new billing units or new customers prior to or at the time service begins.

children.text: What is the requirement for community water systems?

(a) What is the requirement for community water systems? Community water systems must give a copy of the most recent public notice for any continuing violation, the existence of a variance or exemption, or other ongoing situations requiring a public notice to all new billing units or new customers prior to or at the time service begins.
What is the requirement for non-community water systems?

(b) What is the requirement for non-community water systems? Non-community water systems must continuously post the public notice in conspicuous locations in order to inform new consumers of any continuing violation, variance or exemption, or other situation requiring a public notice for as long as the violation, variance, exemption, or other situation persists.
